page.overview:
Who is Unidentified Sith Lord?

At one point, an individual was a prominent Sith Lord. Centuries after his death, the Ankok cult worshiped him and the dark side of the Force while based in a city. The Sith's preserved corpse was held seated on a throne inside a structure in the settlement and was used in ceremonies by the cult. Ankok's leader, Tata, who admired the Sith Lord and viewed herself as his rightful successor, would summon tendrils that extended from the throne toward the awaiting cultists and entered their mouths.

During one gathering of the cult, Tata used the tendrils to immobilize Kako, a young woman who hated both Ankok and the dark side, and the latter person experienced a vision in which she saw the re-animated body of the Sith Lord reach out to her. At that point, the merchant Popo shot a hole into the real corpse's head with a pistol, leading to the Sith's mortal remains dissipating, not long after which Kako killed Tata with a lightsaber.

A Force-sensitive individual was at one point a major and notorious Sith Lord, a member of the Sith tradition of adherents of the dark side of the Force. Centuries after his death, human leader and messenger of the cult, admired the Sith Lord and believed herself to be the rightful successor to him and to the legacy of the Sith.

The Sith Lord's body was preserved in a towering structure in the city. It was seated in a throne that was suspended atop a pole. Ankok would use the mortal remains in a ceremony where Tata stood on a pedestal in front of the lifted seat. At a specific moment, a dark celestial body in the sky above the settlement occulted its light counterpart of the same apparent size, with the phenomenon aligning itself visually in the center of an opening in the wall of the structure behind the corpse. Directed by Tata's powers, at that point, voluminous, flesh-like tendrils began emerging from the throne and reaching toward the expectant cultists—whose mouths they then entered.
